reads.sell: A Right Bank Bordeaux led by Merlot, with plum, black cherry and a little truffle and chocolate on a round, velvety palate. It is gentle enough to open young and lovely with duck, mushrooms or a braise.

why.grape: Plummy red and black fruit with a soft, fleshy middle and round tannin, every line at medium or a step above, is Merlot.
why.climate: Ripe but restrained fruit, an earthy edge, fresh acidity and alcohol short of high say a moderate maritime climate.

reads.sell: A plush California Merlot of black cherry and plum, wrapped in mocha, vanilla and toast from new oak on a soft, round palate. It is an easy match for roast pork, short ribs or a mushroom risotto.

why.grape: Plum and black cherry on a fleshy, round mid palate, with tannin softer than Cabernet Sauvignon's, is Merlot.
why.climate: Ripe to jammy black fruit, alcohol at medium plus or high and acidity no more than medium say a warm climate.
